snippet.title: ICHOROUS - Kickstarter + Demo Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
The ICHOROUS Kickstarter is here! Get ready to shred through enemies and experience the blood-soaked gameplay! You play as the Warlock, bound by contract to the banished god of blood, the Patron, to kill monstrous foes and collect their godly blood, Ichor. In return, you grow more powerful with cursed upgrades that boost your abilities while making your run harder.

Bring Ichorous to life on Kickstarter:
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/monstercrate/ichorous

PLAY THE DEMO on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4050810/Ichorous/

PLAY THE DEMO ON Itch:
https://mattstov.itch.io/ichorous
